Buttons outside the item's form use the `form=` attribute or their own small forms. No action may lose CSRF or the stale-form check (`item_base`).\n- The \"Unsaved changes\" marker follows the Editor's existing dirty state (`body_dirty`) and any field's `input` event.\n- A Report's PDF field and its chart images sit under the Editor.\n- A Report that is locked for an Analyst keeps today's read-only view, in the new layout.\n\n### T24: Dashboard\n\n- Head: \"Dashboard\", today's date, the user's role, and \"New Data Bite\" (plus \"New Report\").\n- Four counts (Data Bites published and drafts, Reports published and drafts), each linking to its filtered list.\n- **01 Waiting for you:**\n  - For a Director: draft Reports, oldest update first, each with \"Review\".\n  - For an Analyst: their own drafts, Data Bites and Reports.\n  - Empty, it says so.\n- **02 Recently changed:** the 8 most recently updated items of both kinds, with a state badge and an ISO date, and a link to All content.\n- **Side panels:** \"The public site\" (publishing reaches it at the next `cms publish`, plus \"View the site ↗\"), and, for a Director, \"Homepage\" (when it was last saved, plus \"Edit homepage\").\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\n- Existing tests keep passing. A test that asserts on today's console markup or a redirect location is updated in the same commit, with the reason.\n- New tests:\n  - Every signed-in console page has the nav and a Log out form with a CSRF token.\n  - An Analyst's nav has no Homepage or Users link.\n  - No admin page links `style.css`; no public page links `admin.css` (kept from T19).\n  - Each list's filter shows only that state, and a bad `?status=` is a 400.\n  - `/admin/data-bites/new` and `/admin/reports/new` render the form, and a create redirects to the new item's edit page.\n  - The edit page's save-bar buttons each post with a CSRF token. A stale form is still refused (409).\n  - \"Waiting for you\": a Director sees draft Reports and not published ones. An Analyst sees their own drafts and not another Analyst's. Nothing from it leaks to a public page.\n- **Browser check** in each closing comment, at 390, 768, and 1440 px in light and dark, with screenshots and `document.fonts`. That covers the nav, a list, a create, an edit with the save bar and the unsaved marker, the dashboard as the Director and as an Analyst, and the Users and Homepage pages.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\n- Any change to the public site.\n- New roles, a review or approval workflow, or a \"submit for review\" state. \"Waiting for you\" is derived from existing states.\n- Recording when `cms publish` last ran.\n- Search in the console.\n- Changes to the Editor's behaviour or the Chart builder's features. They are restyled only.\n\n## Further Notes\n\n- Mockup: `docs/design/admin-console-mockup/` (`index.html`, `data-bites.html`, `edit.html`, `console.css`, and `screenshots/`). Its CSS is the starting point for `static/admin.css`.\n- Stage 2 is due Tue Oct 6, 2:40 pm Eastern. The tickets are ordered so that each one leaves the console working and committed: T21, then T22, then T23, then T24.\n\n## Tickets\n\n- #26 T21: Console shell\n- #27 T22: Lists and create pages\n- #28 T23: Edit pages\n- #29 T24: Dashboard\n\n\n----CONTEXT\n# Kenyon Office of Institutional Research (IR) CMS\n\nA CMS for Kenyon College's Office of Institutional Research: a two-person office\n(Director + Analyst/intern staff) that publishes survey results, data briefs,\nand durable reference documents like the Factbook and Common Data Set.\n\n## Language\n\n**Director**:\nThe admin role. Modeled on the real office's Associate VP for Institutional\nResearch — the only person who can publish or edit a Report, manage user\naccounts, and deactivate access.\n_Avoid_: Admin, superuser\n\n**Analyst**:\nThe editor role. Each intern gets their own named Analyst account (see\nADR-003). Can draft and publish Data Bites directly; can draft but not\npublish or edit Reports. Any Analyst may edit any other Analyst's draft\n(shift continuity), though the original author is preserved.\n_Avoid_: Editor, intern (interns are Analysts, not a separate role), staff\n\n**Data Bite**:\nA Post: a short, dated item — a survey result, an enrollment snapshot, an\nannouncement. The frequent, low-stakes content type. Analysts can publish\nthese without Director approval.\n_Avoid_: Update, post, announcement, article\n\n**Report**:\nA Page: a durable, cite-able reference document — the Factbook, a Common Data\nSet, the Survey Coordination Policy. Appears in public navigation. Only the\nDirector can publish or edit a Report, even one an Analyst drafted.\n_Avoid_: Page, document\n\n**Draft**:\nContent (a Data Bite or Report) that has been saved but not published. Never\nappears on the public site. Used for unreleased data, e.g. enrollment numbers\nstill being verified before the official count.\n_Avoid_: Unpublished, pending\n\n**Published**:\nContent visible on the public site. The one-way gate: a Report only crosses\nit with Director action.\n_Avoid_: Live, public\n\n**State**:\nWhether a Data Bite or Report is a Draft or Published. The Console's lists\nshow it as a badge and filter by it (spec #25, T22). In code and in the\nlists' `?status=`, it is `status`.\n_Avoid_: status (on a page), stage\n\n**Chart image**:\nAn *uploaded* PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a chart made in Excel, R,\nor Tableau) that a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its body with\nthe Editor's \"Insert image\", with a required description, and stored there as\n`image:<name>` (T18). It belongs to its item and is published with\nit (ADR-004). Not a **Chart**, which the CMS draws from data, and not a\nReport's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.\n_Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment\n\n**Chart**:\nA bar, horizontal bar, or line chart the CMS *draws* from data typed or\npasted into it, shown inline in a Data Bite or Report body with its data\navailable as a table (spec #14,\n[ADR-006](docs/adr/ADR-006-charts-drawn-from-data.md)). Stored in the body\nas a `chart` block the writer never sees. Not a **Chart image**, which is made elsewhere and uploaded.\n_Avoid_: graph, plot, visualization\n\n**Chart builder**:\nThe Editor's \"Insert chart\" dialog: a Chart's fields and a grid (categories\ndown, series across) that takes typing or a paste from Excel or Sheets, with\nthe Chart drawn by the server as the writer types and each error beside its\nfield or cell (spec #14, T17). In the body, a Chart shows as a *card*, its\ndrawing with Edit and Remove.\n_Avoid_: chart editor, chart wizard\n\n**Editor**:\nThe visual body editor on a Data Bite's or Report's edit page: a toolbar,\ntables edited in place, Charts, and Chart images, with no Markdown in sight.\nThe body is still stored as Markdown (spec #14,\n[ADR-005](docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md)). A part of a body it\ncan't represent is a **locked block**: shown read-only, kept byte for byte.\n_Avoid_: WYSIWYG, rich text, rich-text editor\n\n**Site link**:\nA link in a Data Bite's or Report's body to another Data Bite or Report,\npicked from a list in the Editor and stored by the target's immutable\nreference, its *site reference* (`report:<ref>`, `data-bite:<ref>`), never\nits title, slug, or id.\nIt is a link on the site only while its target is Published; otherwise it\nshows as plain text (spec #14, T14).\n_Avoid_: internal link, cross-reference\n\n**Address**:\nWhere a Data Bite's or Report's page is on the site: its type's folder, its\nslug, and `.html` (e.g. `data-bites/fall-enrollment.html`). The edit page\nshows the slug as an Address field, the folder and `.html` either side of it\n(spec #25, T23). In code, and in the form, the part typed is the `slug`.\n_Avoid_: URL, permalink, slug (on a page)\n\n**Site preview**:\nA Draft (or unsaved edits) rendered as its public page would look, with the\nsite's nav and stylesheet and a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner. Saves\nnothing and publishes nothing.\n_Avoid_: live view\n\n**Summary**:\nOne or two sentences of plain text about a Data Bite or Report, at most 200\ncharacters, written under its title on the edit form. Shown under the title\non its page, in the lists and the Reports table, and in its page's\ndescription and link-preview tags (spec #22, T20). Optional: an item without\none shows nothing in its place.\n_Avoid_: excerpt, abstract, description, blurb\n\n**Homepage settings**:\nThe homepage's headline, its accent (the end of the headline, in bright\npurple), its intro, and its Key figures. Edited by the Director only, at\n/admin/homepage. Settings, not content: no Draft, and on the public site from\nthe next `cms publish`, like a change to the nav (spec #22, T20).\n_Avoid_: hero, homepage content\n\n**Key figure**:\nOne of up to four numbers on the homepage, each a value, a label saying what\nit counts, and an optional note saying when or of whom (e.g. \"1,805\" /\n\"Students enrolled\" / \"Fall 2026 census\"). Typed text, not drawn from data.\n_Avoid_: stat, KPI, metric\n\n**Site search**:\nThe public site's search of published titles and Summaries, entirely static:\n`cms publish` writes `search-index.json` and `search.html`, and\n`search.js` searches the index in the browser. Without JavaScript,\n`search.html` lists every published item. Bodies are not searched (spec #22,\nT20).\n_Avoid_: search engine, full-text search\n\n**Confirmation**:\nThe one-line message the admin console shows, once, after a save, publish,\nupload, delete, or user change succeeds (`app/flash.py`). Fixed text only:\nnever a title, email, filename, or password. A refused action gets an error,\nnot a Confirmation.\n_Avoid_: flash, toast, notification, success message\n\n**Console**:\nThe admin console: the local, signed-in app where the Director and Analysts\nwrite and publish content, never on the public internet. Every page has the\nsame bar: numbered nav (01 Dashboard, 02 Data Bites, 03 Reports, and, for\nthe Director, 04 Homepage and 05 Users), who is signed in, \"View site ↗\",\nand Log out (spec #25, T21). Its home page is the **Dashboard**.\n_Avoid_: back end, dashboard (that is its home page only)\n\n**Factbook**:\nA specific Report: the office's running reference document of admissions,\nenrollment, diversity, and academic program statistics.\n\n**Common Data Set (CDS)**:\nA specific Report: a standardized annual institutional data submission,\npublished publicly.\n\n**Survey Calendar**:\nA specific Report: the schedule of past, current, and upcoming surveys the\noffice runs (e.g. faculty/staff surveys, external review surveys).","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"4cf0c82c-0ad6-4330-97a4-9a9031dfb127","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":7},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d611ec46-5cc4-46fc-af9e-0dfdadee69c6","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"61d98248-06af-4e3c-b9d5-bf156cfc033d","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"d86ed253-db9f-45b9-bb04-81d627538361","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e9b2ec22-f052-48bf-a0c0-513c3e036782","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017ByydB9AfmnphhVemh4TLT","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"What the console's item lists share (spec #25, T22): the Data Bites,\nReports, and All content pages show one `table-items` table, each row an\nitem's title and Summary, its State, author, last update, and the actions the\nsigned-in user may take on it; and they filter by State with `?status=`.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom types import ModuleType\nfrom typing import NamedTuple\n\nfrom fastapi import HTTPException, Query, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports\nfrom app.content import STATUS_LABELS\nfrom app.templating import templates\nfrom app.users import is_director\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentType:\n    key: str          # e.g. \"data-bite\", as used in ids and query strings\n    noun: str         # e.g. \"Data Bite\"\n    plural: str       # e.g. \"Data Bites\"\n    module: ModuleType\n    id_param: str     # its routes' id parameter, e.g. \"bite_id\"\n    list_route: str   # its admin routes' names, for url_path_for / path_for\n    edit_route: str\n    delete_route: str  # the confirm-delete page\n    site_route: str   # its public page's route, e.g. \"data_bite\"\n    folder: str       # its pages' folder on the site, the start of its Address\n    director_publishes: bool  # only a Director may publish or unpublish one\n    can_edit: Callable[[sqlite3.Row, sqlite3.Row], bool]  # (item, user): else read-only\n\n\nDATA_BITE = ContentType(\"data-bite\", \"Data Bite\", \"Data Bites\", data_bites, \"bite_id\",\n                        \"list_bites\", \"edit_bite_form\", \"confirm_delete_bite\",\n                        \"data_bite\", \"data-bites/\", director_publishes=False,\n                        can_edit=lambda item, user: True)\nREPORT = ContentType(\"report\", \"Report\", \"Reports\", reports, \"report_id\",\n                     \"list_reports\", \"edit_report_form\", \"confirm_delete_report\",\n                     \"report\", \"reports/\", director_publishes=True,\n                     can_edit=reports.can_edit)\nCONTENT_TYPES = (DATA_BITE, REPORT)\n\n# The State filters, in order: the query value (\"\" for all) and its label.\nSTATUS_FILTERS = ((\"\", \"All\"), (\"published\", \"Published\"), (\"draft\", \"Drafts\"))\n\n\ndef _one_of(value: str, allowed, name: str) -> str:\n    if value not in (\"\", *allowed):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f\"Unknown {name} filter.\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef status_filter(status: str = \"\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"`?status=` as a route dependency: \"\" (all), or a State. 400 for any\n    other value.\"\"\"\n    return _one_of(status, STATUS_LABELS, \"status\")\n\n\ndef type_filter(content_type: str = Query(\"\", alias=\"type\")) -> str:\n    \"\"\"All content's `?type=`: \"\" (all), or a type's key. 400 for any other\n    value.\"\"\"\n    return _one_of(content_type, [ctype.key for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES], \"type\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ItemRow:\n    \"\"\"One row of a list: the item, its type, what the user may do with it,\n    and where each action goes, from the routes.\"\"\"\n    ctype: ContentType\n    item: sqlite3.Row\n    may_edit: bool             # else its page is read-only for the user (\"View\")\n    edit_path: str\n    status_path: str | None    # publish a draft, or unpublish; None if not the user's to do.\n                               # It returns to the list filtered as it was, or,\n                               # posted with back=item, to the edit page.\n    delete_path: str | None    # Director only\n\n\ndef item_row(request: Request, ctype: ContentType, item: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row,\n             *, back_status: str = \"\") -> ItemRow:\n    \"\"\"`item`'s row for `user`. `back_status` is the list's State filter, which\n    Publish and Unpublish return to.\"\"\"\n    def path(route: str) -> str:\n        # The publish and unpublish routes share their names across the types;\n        # the id parameter picks the type's.\n        return str(request.app.url_path_for(route, **{ctype.id_param: item[\"id\"]}))\n\n    director = is_director(user)\n    may_publish = director or not ctype.director_publishes\n    action = \"unpublish\" if item[\"status\"] == \"published\" else \"publish\"\n    back = f\"?status={back_status}\" if back_status else \"\"\n    return ItemRow(ctype, item, may_edit=ctype.can_edit(item, user),\n                   edit_path=path(ctype.edit_route),\n                   status_path=path(action) + back if may_publish else None,\n                   delete_path=path(ctype.delete_route) if director else None)\n\n\n# A Publish or Unpublish form's `back` from an edit page's save bar (T23).\nBACK_TO_ITEM = \"item\"\n\n\ndef after_status_change(request: Request, ctype: ContentType, item_id: int, *,\n                        back: str, back_status: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    \"\"\"Where Publish or Unpublish returns: the item's edit page if posted from\n    its save bar (`back`), else the type's list, filtered by `back_status` as\n    it was.\"\"\"\n    if back == BACK_TO_ITEM:\n        path = str(request.app.url_path_for(ctype.edit_route, **{ctype.id_param: item_id}))\n    else:\n        path = str(request.app.url_path_for(ctype.list_route))\n        path += f\"?status={back_status}\" if back_status else \"\"\n    return RedirectResponse(path, status_code=303)\n\n\nclass StateFilter(NamedTuple):\n    href: str\n    label: str\n    count: int     # how many items it shows\n    current: bool  # the one shown\n\n\ndef filters(path: str, counts: dict[str, int], chosen: str) -> list[StateFilter]:\n    \"\"\"The State filters for the list at `path`.\"\"\"\n    return [StateFilter(f\"{path}?status={value}\" if value else path, label,\n                        counts[value] if value else sum(counts.values()), value == chosen)\n            for value, label in STATUS_FILTERS]\n\n\ndef list_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, ctype: ContentType, status: str,\n              template: str):\n    \"\"\"A type's own list, `template`, narrowed to `status` (\"\" for all).\"\"\"\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, template,\n        {\"title\": ctype.plural, \"user\": user, \"ctype\": ctype,\n         \"rows\": [item_row(request, ctype, item, user, back_status=status)\n                  for item in ctype.module.list_all(status or None)],\n         \"filters\": filters(request.url.path, ctype.module.count_by_status(), status),\n         \"status\": status, \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS},\n    )\n\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields and\nthe Summary, their validation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n\nEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\nData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\nexports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import charts, db, site_links\nfrom app.rendering import parse\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show. `field` names the\n    form field it is about, to be shown beside, if it is about one.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str, field: str | None = None):\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.field = field\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\nSTALE = \"This item changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version.\"\n\n\nclass StaleItem(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"Saved from an edit form opened on an older version of the item.\"\"\"\n\n\n# A Summary's limit, in characters (code points), which the edit form counts\n# the same way (spec #22).\nSUMMARY_MAX = 200\n\n\ndef item_base(title: str, slug: str, body: str, summary: str = \"\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"The version of an item an edit form was opened on: a hash of its\n    stored title, slug, body, and Summary, all of which the form saves. A\n    hash of the body alone would let a stale form overwrite a newer title or\n    slug.\"\"\"\n    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([title, slug, body, summary]).encode()).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef one_line(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Plain text as a Summary or a Homepage setting is stored: its runs of\n    whitespace, line breaks too, as single spaces, trimmed.\"\"\"\n    return \" \".join(text.split())\n\n\ndef validate_summary(summary: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A Summary as stored: plain text on one line, its runs of whitespace\n    (line breaks too) as single spaces, trimmed. Empty is allowed: it's\n    optional. ContentError, about the summary field, if it is too long.\"\"\"\n    summary = one_line(summary)\n    if len(summary) > SUMMARY_MAX:\n        raise ContentError(f\"Keep the summary to {SUMMARY_MAX} characters or fewer; \"\n                           f\"it has {len(summary)}.\", field=\"summary\")\n    return summary\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\", field=\"title\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\", field=\"slug\")\n    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page; \"\n                           \"choose another.\", field=\"slug\")\n    if not body.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\", field=\"body\")\n    try:\n        # Every save, from the Editor or not (spec #14, ADR-006).\n        charts.check(parse(body))\n    except charts.ChartError as exc:\n        raise ContentError(str(exc), field=\"body\") from None\n    return title, slug, body\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentTable:\n    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n    kind: str   # e.g. \"report\", its site links' scheme (app.site_links)\n\n    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n                params,\n            ).fetchall()\n\n    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n            raise exc\n        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\",\n                             field=\"slug\")\n\n    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n               summary: str = \"\", also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Create a draft, with a new ref.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        summary = validate_summary(summary)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                # Held from choosing the ref to storing it (site_links.new_ref).\n                conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n                item_id = conn.execute(\n                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, summary, author_id, ref)\"\n                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, summary, author_id, site_links.new_ref(conn)),\n                ).lastrowid\n                if also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n        return item_id\n\n    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n               summary: str = \"\", drafts_only: bool = False,\n               also: AlsoWrite | None = None, base: str | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, body, and Summary. The author, created_at, and status are\n        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. With `base`,\n        the item_base the edit form was opened on, StaleItem if the item has\n        changed since, and nothing is written. False if nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        summary = validate_summary(summary)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                if base is not None:\n                    # Held from the check to the write, so no other save\n                    # lands between them.\n                    conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n                    row = conn.execute(f\"SELECT title, slug, body, summary FROM {self.table}\"\n                                       \" WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).fetchone()\n                    if row is not None and item_base(*row) != base:\n                        raise StaleItem(STALE)\n                changed = conn.execute(\n                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, summary = ?,\"\n                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, summary, item_id, drafts_only),\n                ).rowcount == 1\n                if changed and also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n                return changed\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n\n    def touch(self, item_id: int, *, drafts_only: bool = False,\n              also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Mark the item as changed now, for a change outside its row (e.g.\n        its images), made by `also` in the same transaction. With drafts_only,\n        a published item is left alone, as `update`. False if nothing was\n        changed.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            changed = conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ? \"\"\"`item`'s row for `user`. `back_status` is the list's State filter, which\n    Publish and Unpublish return to.\"\"\"\n    def path(route: str) -> str:\n        # The publish and unpublish routes Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import charts, db, site_links\nfrom app.rendering import parse\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show. `field` names the\n    form field it is about, to be shown beside, if it is about one.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str, field: str | None = None):\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.field = field\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\nSTALE = \"This item changed since you opened it. Empty is allowed: it's\n    optional. With drafts_only,\n        a published item is left alone, as `update`. Everything is plain text, escaped\nwhere it is shown. A fresh database is seeded with SAMPLE, so a new site has\na homepage to look at; the Director replaces its figures with real ones.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import asdict, dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.content import one_line\n\nFIGURES_MAX = 4\n# Each field's limit in characters, the Key figures' by part.\nLIMITS = {\"headline\": 80, \"headline_accent\": 60, \"intro\": 300,\n          \"value\": 16, \"label\": 40, \"note\": 40}\n\n\nclass SettingsError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A setting broke a rule; the message is safe to show. `field` is the\n    form field it is about, e.g. \"intro\" or \"figure_label_2\".\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str, field: str):\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.field = field\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass KeyFigure:\n    value: str  # e.g. \"1,805\"\n    label: str  # what it counts, e.g. \"Students enrolled\"\n    note: str   # optional: when or of whom, e.g. \"Fall 2026 census\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Homepage:\n    headline: str\n    headline_accent: str  # shown after the headline, in bright purple\n    intro: str\n    key_figures: tuple[KeyFigure, ...]\n\n\nSAMPLE = Homepage(\n    headline=\"The college's numbers,\", headline_accent=\"the day they're final.\",\n    intro=\"Enrollment, retention, outcomes and survey results from Kenyon's \"\n          \"Office of Institutional Research.\",\n    key_figures=(KeyFigure(\"1,805\", \"Students enrolled\", \"Fall 2026 KeyFigure(\"87%\", \"Six-year graduation\", \"Class entering 2020\")))\n\ndef _row(settings: Homepage) -> tuple[str, str, str, str]:\n    return (settings.headline, settings.headline_accent, settings.intro,\n            json.dumps([asdict(figure) for figure in settings.key_figures]))\n\n\ndef seed(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Put SAMPLE in the table if it has no row yet (db.init_db).\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO homepage\"\n                 \" (id, headline, headline_accent, intro, key_figures)\"\n                 \" VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?, ?)\", _row(SAMPLE))\n\n\ndef get() -> Homepage:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM homepage WHERE id = 1\").fetchone()\n    return Homepage(row[\"headline\"], raise SettingsError(f\"Keep {what} to {LIMITS[limit]} characters or fewer; \"\n                            f\"it has {len(text)}.\", field)\n    return text\n\n\ndef from_form(form: Mapping[str, str]) -> Homepage:\n    \"\"\"The settings a posted form gives: headline, headline_accent, intro,\n    and figure_value_<n>, figure_label_<n>, figure_note_<n> for n from 1 to\n    FIGURES_MAX. A blank Key figure row is dropped and the rest close up; a\n    row with a value needs a label, and the other way round. SettingsError\n    on the first field that breaks a rule.\"\"\"\n    headline = _text(form, \"headline\", \"headline\", \"the headline\")\n    if not headline:\n        raise SettingsError(\"Enter a headline.\", \"headline\")\n    accent = _text(form, \"headline_accent\", \"headline_accent\", \"the accent\")\n    intro = _text(form, \"intro\", \"intro\", \"the intro\")\n    figures = []\n    for n in range(1, FIGURES_MAX + 1):\n        value, label, note = (_text(form, f\"figure_{part}_{n}\", part, f\"a figure's {part}\")\n                              for part in (\"value\", \"label\", \"note\"))\n        if not (value or label or note):\n            continue\n        if not value:\n            raise SettingsError(\"Enter the figure itself, e.g. 1,805.\", f\"figure_value_{n}\")\n        if not label:\n            raise SettingsError(\"Say what the figure counts, e.g. Students enrolled.\",\n                                f\"figure_label_{n}\")\n        figures.append(KeyFigure(value, label, note))\n    return Homepage(headline, accent, intro, tuple(figures))\n\n\ndef form_of(settings: Homepage) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"`settings` as the edit form's fields, the inverse of from_form; {"parentUuid":"95ad9996-1ebf-4eb9-b132-ff748bbc28e8","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e9b2ec22-f052-48bf-a0c0-513c3e036782","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01QDP5CdyAozQqfXGrD8BZhz","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"T06: Admin console — dashboard, filterable content list, Markdown preview\n(issue #7). The preview is now the Site preview (T12, issue #15); these check\nthat it still renders and sanitizes the Markdown as it did.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form\n\n\ndef create(c: TestClient, kind: str, slug: str, *, body: str = \"Some **Markdown**.\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft of `kind` (\"data-bites\" or \"reports\"); its id.\"\"\"\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/{kind}\", {\"title\": slug.title(), \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body})\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    # A create lands on the new item's edit page (T22).\n    return response.headers[\"location\"].removeprefix(f\"/admin/{kind}/\")\n\n\ndef publish(director: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str) -> None:\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef dashboard_counts(c: TestClient) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"The dashboard's count cells, e.g. {\"data-bite-draft\": \"2\", ...}.\"\"\"\n    return dict(re.findall(r'<td id=\"count-([a-z-]+)\">(?:<a [^>]+>)?(\\d+)(?:</a>)?</td>',\n                           c.get(\"/admin\").text))\n\n\n# --- Dashboard ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_dashboard_starts_at_zero(client_as):\n    assert dashboard_counts(client_as(\"editor\")) == {\n        \"data-bite-draft\": \"0\", \"data-bite-published\": \"0\", \"data-bite-total\": \"0\",\n        \"report-draft\": \"0\", \"report-published\": \"0\", \"report-total\": \"0\",\n    }\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_counts_each_type_by_status(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    for slug in (\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"):\n        create(analyst, \"data-bites\", slug)\n    publish(analyst, \"data-bites\", create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"d\"))\n    create(analyst, \"reports\", \"factbook\")\n    publish(director, \"reports\", create(analyst, \"reports\", \"cds\"))\n    publish(director, \"reports\", create(director, \"reports\", \"survey-calendar\"))\n\n    expected = {\n        \"data-bite-draft\": \"3\", \"data-bite-published\": \"1\", \"data-bite-total\": \"4\",\n        \"report-draft\": \"1\", \"report-published\": \"2\", \"report-total\": \"3\",\n    }\n    assert dashboard_counts(analyst) == expected\n    assert dashboard_counts(director) == expected\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_counts_follow_unpublish_and_delete(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    bite = create(director, \"data-bites\", \"a\")\n    publish(director, \"data-bites\", bite)\n    report = create(director, \"reports\", \"factbook\")\n    publish(director, \"reports\", report)\n\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bite}/unpublish\", {}).status_code == 303\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/reports/{report}/delete\", {}).status_code == 303\n\n    counts = dashboard_counts(director)\n    assert (counts[\"data-bite-draft\"], counts[\"data-bite-published\"]) == (\"1\", \"0\")\n    assert counts[\"report-total\"] == \"0\"\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_uses_the_glossary_labels(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    for label in (\"Data Bites\", \"Reports\", \"Draft\", \"Published\"):\n        assert label in page\n\n\n# --- Content list ------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef listed(c: TestClient, query: str = \"\") -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"The content list's rows as (type, title, status), top to bottom. The\n    list is the console's item table since T22: the type above the title, and\n    the state as a badge.\"\"\"\n    response = c.get(f\"/admin/content{query}\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text\n    return re.findall(r'<tr id=\"[a-z-]+-\\d+\" role=\"row\">.*?<span class=\"table-items-type text-label\">([^<]+)'\n                      r'</span><a href=\"[^\"]+\">([^<]+)</a>.*?<span class=\"badge-state [a-z-]+\">'\n                      r'(Draft|Published)</span>', response.text, re.S)\n\n\ndef mixed_content(director: TestClient, analyst: TestClient) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Two Data Bites and two Reports, one of each published.\"\"\"\n    create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"bite-draft\")\n    publish(analyst, \"data-bites\", create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"bite-live\"))\n    create(analyst, \"reports\", \"report-draft\")\n    publish(director, \"reports\", create(analyst, \"reports\", \"report-live\"))\n\n\ndef test_content_list_shows_both_types_newest_first(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    mixed_content(director, analyst)\n    with db.connect() as conn:  # setup: make \"bite-draft\" the most recently updated\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE data_bites SET updated_at = '2999-01-01 00:00:00'\"\n                     \" WHERE slug = 'bite-draft'\")\n\n    rows = listed(analyst)\n    assert rows[0] == (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Draft\", \"Draft\")\n    assert sorted(rows) == [\n        (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Draft\", \"Draft\"), (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Live\", \"Published\"),\n        (\"Report\", \"Report-Draft\", \"Draft\"), (\"Report\", \"Report-Live\", \"Published\"),\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_content_list_filters_by_type(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    mixed_content(director, analyst)\n    assert {r[:2] for r in listed(analyst, \"?type=report\")} == {\n        (\"Report\", \"Report-Draft\"), (\"Report\", \"Report-Live\")}\n    assert {r[:2] for r in listed(analyst, \"?type=data-bite\")} == {\n        (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Draft\"), (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Live\")}\n\n\ndef test_content_list_filters_by_status(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    mixed_content(director, analyst)\n    assert sorted(listed(analyst, \"?status=draft\")) == [\n        (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Draft\", \"Draft\"), (\"Report\", \"Report-Draft\", \"Draft\")]\n    assert sorted(listed(analyst, \"?status=published\")) == [\n        (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Live\", \"Published\"), (\"Report\", \"Report-Live\", \"Published\")]\n\n\ndef test_content_list_filters_combine(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    mixed_content(director, analyst)\n    assert listed(director, \"?type=report&status=published\") == [\n        (\"Report\", \"Report-Live\", \"Published\")]\n    # {"parentUuid":"3cf25229-6b17-45a8-bcd3-414571d75685","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e9b2ec22-f052-48bf-a0c0-513c3e036782","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013bMeX4HQdgGVLNgL8RDRbQ","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded user of that role — it works as soon as your login route exists,\nso access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db, settings, users\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"[REDACTED]\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"[REDACTED]\"},\n}\n\n\ndef csrf_from(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', html)\n    assert match, \"no csrf_token field in the page\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef post_form(c: TestClient, path: str, data: dict, *, with_csrf=True):\n    \"\"\"POST an admin form as the logged-in client, with the session's CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    if with_csrf:\n        data = {**data, \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)}\n    return c.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef user_row(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"This user's row of the Director's user list, as HTML.\"\"\"\n    for row in director.get(\"/admin/users\").text.split(\"<tr\")[1:]:\n        if email in row:\n            return row\n    raise AssertionError(f\"{email} is not listed\")\n\n\ndef user_id(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    return re.match(r' id=\"user-(\\d+)\"', user_row(director, email)).group(1)\n\n\ndef second_analyst(director: TestClient) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"A logged-in client for a second, named Analyst (not the seeded one).\"\"\"\n    account = {\"name\": \"Riley Intern\", \"email\": \"riley@example.test\",\n               \"password\": \"[REDACTED]\", \"role\": \"editor\"}\n    assert post_form(director, \"/admin/users\", account).status_code == 303\n    c = TestClient(create_app())\n    token = csrf_from(c.get(\"/login\").text)\n    c.post(\"/login\", data={**account, \"csrf_token\": token})\n    return c\n\n\ndef stored_id(table: str, slug: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The id of the item stored in `table` with `slug`. The admin lists show\n    titles, not slugs (T22), so tests find an item's row by its id.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(f\"SELECT id FROM {table} WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone()\n    assert row, f\"no {table} item has the slug {slug}\"\n    return str(row[0])\n\n\ndef stored_slugs(table: str) -> set[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every slug stored in `table`: whether a refused save left an item\n    behind, which the admin lists, showing titles, no longer say (T22).\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return {row[0] for row in conn.execute(f\"SELECT slug FROM {table}\")}\n\n\ndef backdate(table: str, row_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Setup only: move a content row's timestamps into the past, so an edit\n    made within the same second still visibly changes updated_at.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET created_at = '2026-01-05 09:00:00',\"\n                     \" updated_at = '2026-01-05 09:00:00' WHERE id = ?\", (row_id,))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef seeded_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"Every test gets its own database holding the DEMO_USERS, and its own\n    uploads directory. No deployed URL either, whatever a local .env says; a\n    test that needs one sets it.\"\"\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", tmp_path / \"test.db\")\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"UPLOADS\", tmp_path / \"uploads\")\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n    db.init_db()\n    for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():\n        users.create_user(user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"], role)\n    return settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client() -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as():\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = TestClient(create_app())\n        form = c.get(\"/login\")\n        if form.status_code == 404:\n            pytest.skip(\"No /login route yet — build the login ticket first.\")\n        response = c.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": user[\"email\"],\n                                          \"password\": user[\"password\"],\n                                          \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(form.text)},\n                          follow_redirects=False)\n        assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 303), (\n            f\"Login as {role} failed with {response.status_code}\")\n        return c\n\n    return _login\n46:@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {\n71:.text-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); No deployed URL either, whatever a local .env says; a\n    test that needs one sets it.\"\"\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", tmp_path / \"test.db\")\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"UPLOADS\", tmp_path / \"uploads\")\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n    db.init_db()\n    for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():\n        users.create_user(user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"], role)\n    return settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client() -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as():\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = TestClient(create_app())\n        form = c.get(\"/login\")\n        if form.status_code == 404:\n            pytest.skip(\"No /login route yet — build the login ticket first.\")\n        response = c.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": user[\"email\"],\n                                          \"password\": user[\"password\"],\n                                          \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(form.text)},\n                          follow_redirects=False)\n        assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 303), (\n            f\"Login as {role} failed with {response.status_code}\")\n        return c\n\n    return _login\n46:@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {\n71:.text-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); {"parentUuid":"56846683-e1a4-4f82-8bba-93353eca0722","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e9b2ec22-f052-48bf-a0c0-513c3e036782","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CEMG9GoVBAvRTM8FVPbq9s","type":"tool_result","content":"{#- The console's item table (spec #25, T22), for the Data Bites, Reports,\n    and All content lists: `rows` (app.routes.listing.ItemRow), and the\n    first column's head, `noun`. With `show_type`, each title says its type.\n    On a phone its rows stack; the explicit roles keep it a table to a screen\n    reader, which some browsers stop reading it as once its CSS display\n    changes (as T20's Reports table). #}\n  <table class=\"table-items table-items-stack\" role=\"table\">\n    <thead role=\"rowgroup\"><tr role=\"row\"><th role=\"columnheader\" scope=\"col\">{{ noun }}</th><th role=\"columnheader\" scope=\"col\">State</th><th role=\"columnheader\" scope=\"col\">Author</th><th role=\"columnheader\" scope=\"col\">Updated</th><th role=\"columnheader\" scope=\"col\"><span class=\"text-hidden\">Actions</span></th></tr></thead>\n    <tbody role=\"rowgroup\">\n    {%- for row in rows %}\n      {%- set item = row.item %}\n      <tr id=\"{{ row.ctype.key }}-{{ item.id }}\" role=\"row\">\n        <th role=\"rowheader\" scope=\"row\" class=\"table-items-title\">\n          {%- if show_type %}<span class=\"table-items-type text-label\">{{ row.ctype.noun }}</span>{% endif -%}\n          <a href=\"{{ row.edit_path }}\">{{ item.title }}</a>\n          {%- if item.summary %}<p>{{ item.summary }}</p>{% endif -%}\n        </th>\n        <td role=\"cell\"><span class=\"badge-state badge-state-{{ item.status }}\">{{ status_labels[item.status] }}</span></td>\n        <td role=\"cell\">{{ item.author_name }}</td>\n        <td role=\"cell\" class=\"text-mono\"><time datetime=\"{{ item.updated_at | replace(\" \", \"T\") }}\">{{ item.updated_at[:10] }}</time></td>\n        <td role=\"cell\" class=\"table-items-actions\">\n          <a class=\"button-quiet\" href=\"{{ row.edit_path }}\">{{ \"Edit\" if row.may_edit else \"View\" }}</a>\n          {%- if row.status_path %}\n          <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ row.status_path }}\">\n            <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n            <button class=\"button-quiet\" type=\"submit\">{{ \"Unpublish\" if item.status == \"published\" else \"Publish\" }}</button>\n          </form>\n          {%- endif %}\n          {%- if row.delete_path %}\n          <a class=\"button-quiet button-danger\" href=\"{{ row.delete_path }}\">Delete</a>\n          {%- endif %}\n        </td>\n      </tr>\n    {%- endfor %}\n    </tbody>\n  </table>\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <div class=\"head-page\"><div>\n    <span class=\"head-page-crumbs text-label\"><a href=\"{{ back }}\">All {{ noun }}s</a></span>\n    <h1>Delete {{ noun }}</h1>\n    <p class=\"head-page-lede\">Delete <strong>{{ item.title }}</strong>? This can't be undone.</p>\n  </div></div>\n  <section class=\"section-console\" aria-labelledby=\"linked-title\">\n    <div class=\"head-section\"><span class=\"text-mono\">01</span><h2 id=\"linked-title\">What links to it</h2></div>\n    {% if linked_from %}\n    <p>These link to it. Once it is deleted, each of those links shows as plain text:</p>\n    <ul class=\"list-console\">\n      {% for found in linked_from %}\n      <li><span class=\"text-label text-muted\">{{ found.noun }}</span> <a href=\"{{ path_for('edit_bite_form', bite_id=found.id) if found.kind == 'data-bite' else path_for('edit_report_form', report_id=found.id) }}\">{{ found.title }}</a></li>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </ul>\n    {% else %}\n    <p>No other Report or Data Bite links to it.</p>\n    {% endif %}\n  </section>\n  <form class=\"actions-form\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ action }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <button class=\"button-secondary button-danger\" type=\"submit\">Delete {{ noun }}</button>\n    <a class=\"button-quiet\" href=\"{{ back }}\">Cancel</a>\n  </form>\n{% endblock %}\ntemplates/admin/_items_table.html:20:        <td role=\"cell\" class=\"text-mono\"><time datetime=\"{{ item.updated_at | replace(\" \", \"T\") }}\">{{ item.updated_at[:10] }}</time></td>\ntemplates/admin/_edit_head.html:4:{%- macro iso_date(stamp) %}<time datetime=\"{{ stamp | replace(\" \", \"T\") }}\">{{ stamp[:10] }}</time>{% endmacro %}\ntemplates/admin/_edit_head.html:12:      <div><dt>Updated</dt><dd class=\"text-mono\">{{ iso_date(item.updated_at) }}</dd></div>\n\"\"\"T22: Lists and create pages (issue #27, spec #25).\n\nThe Data Bites, Reports, and All content lists are one `table-items` table:\neach item's title with its Summary, a state badge, its author, when it was\nlast updated (ISO), and the actions the user may take. The two type lists\nfilter by state with `?status=`. Creating an item has its own page, and a\ncreate lands on the new item's edit page.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT\n\nLISTS = {\"data-bites\": (\"data-bite\", BITE), \"reports\": (\"report\", REPORT)}\n\n\ndef create(c: TestClient, kind: str, slug: str, **fields) -> str:\n    _, item = LISTS[kind]\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/{kind}\", {**item, \"slug\": slug, \"title\": slug.title(),\n                                               **fields})\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return response.headers[\"location\"].rsplit(\"/\", 1)[1]\n\n\ndef published_and_draft(kind: str, director: TestClient) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    live, draft = create(director, kind, \"live\"), create(director, kind, \"draft\")\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}/{live}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n    return live, draft\n\n\ndef row_ids(html: str, key: str) -> list[str]:\n    return re.findall(rf'<tr id=\"{key}-(\\d+)\"', html)\n\n\ndef row(html: str, key: str, item_id: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(rf'<tr id=\"{key}-{item_id}\" role=\"row\">(.*?)</tr>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"{key}-{item_id} is not listed\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef filters(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, bool]]:\n    \"\"\"The filter links as (href, label, count, current).\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'<nav class=\"filters-console\" aria-label=\"Filter by state\">(.*?)</nav>',\n                      html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no state filters\"\n    return [(href, label, count, bool(current)) for href, current, label, count in re.findall(\n        r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"( aria-current=\"page\")?>([^<]+)<span class=\"text-mono\">(\\d+)</span></a>',\n        match.group(1))]\n\n\n# --- The table ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", A Report locked\nfor an Analyst keeps its read-only view.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from, post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import create_report\nfrom tests.test_t13_editor_routes import STALE, save\n\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", create_bite, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", create_report, id=\"report\")]\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\ndef save_bar(page: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(r'<div class=\"bar-save\" role=\"region\" aria-label=\"Save\">(.*?)</div></div>',\n                      page, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no save bar\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef form_with_id(page: str, form_id: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(rf'<form id=\"{form_id}\"[^>]*>(.*?)</form>', create_bite(analyst, slug=\"unreleased-bite\", title=\"Unreleased enrollment count\")\n    rid = published_report(director)\n    assert post_with_file(director, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\", REPORT, pdf()).status_code == 303\n    published_report(director, slug=\"cds\", title=\"Common Data Set 2025-26\")\n\n\ndef test_the_export_is_the_live_public_site(client_as, client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Same pages, same paths, same bytes: one rendering, not two. {"parentUuid":"2638494e-2e21-4810-b3a8-fec93dce4631","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfcNmgQ21X1F5tWnKWuCN","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013bzsWtvGMGy74ir7APS8d7","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t24_dashboard.py","content":"\"\"\"T24: Dashboard (issue #29, spec #25).\n\nThe Console's home page shows each person what needs their attention: four\ncounts, each linking to its filtered list; \"Waiting for you\", draft Reports\nfor the Director and an Analyst's own drafts; the 8 most recently changed\nitems; and side panels for the public site and, for the Director, the\nHomepage settings. All of it is derived from what is stored.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form, second_analyst\nfrom tests.test_t22_lists import create\n\n\ndef section(page: str, title_id: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(rf'<section class=\"section-console\" aria-labelledby=\"{title_id}\">(.*?)</section>',\n                      page, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"no section #{title_id}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef listed(page: str, title_id: str, list_key: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"A section's items, top to bottom, as \"<type key>-<id>\".\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(rf'<li id=\"{list_key}-([a-z-]+-\\d+)\"', section(page, title_id))\n\n\ndef waiting(c: TestClient) -> list[str]:\n    return listed(c.get(\"/admin\").text, \"waiting-title\", \"waiting\")\n\n\ndef recent(c: TestClient) -> list[str]:\n    return listed(c.get(\"/admin\").text, \"recent-title\", \"recent\")\n\n\ndef item(page: str, list_key: str, key: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(rf'<li id=\"{list_key}-{key}\">(.*?)</li>', page, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"{list_key}-{key} is not listed\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef set_updated(table: str, item_id: str, stamp: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Setup only: when an item was last updated.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\", (stamp, item_id))\n\n\ndef publish(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str) -> None:\n    assert post_form(c, f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n\n\n# --- The head ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_the_head_has_today_the_role_and_both_new_buttons(client_as):\n    today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat()  # stored times are UTC\n    for role, label in ((\"admin\", \"Director\"), (\"editor\", \"Analyst\")):\n        page = client_as(role).get(\"/admin\").text\n        head = re.search(r'<div class=\"head-page\">(.*?)</div>\\s*<dl class=\"figures-console\">',\n                         page, re.S).group(1)\n        assert \"<h1>Dashboard</h1>\" in head\n        assert f'<dt>Today</dt><dd class=\"text-mono\"><time datetime=\"{today}\">{today}</time></dd>' in head\n        assert f\"<dt>Signed in as</dt><dd>{label}</dd>\" in head\n        assert '<a class=\"button-secondary\" href=\"/admin/reports/new\">New Report</a>' in head\n        assert '<a class=\"button-primary\" href=\"/admin/data-bites/new\">New Data Bite</a>' in head\n\n\n# --- The counts ----------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef counts(c: TestClient) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Each count as {id: (href, label, number)}.\"\"\"\n    return {key: (href, label, number) for key, href, label, number in re.findall(\n        r'<div id=\"count-([a-z-]+)\"><dt><a href=\"([^\"]+)\">([^<]+)</a></dt>'\n        r'<dd class=\"text-mono\">(\\d+)</dd></div>', c.get(\"/admin\").text)}\n\n\ndef test_four_counts_each_linking_to_its_filtered_list(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    for slug in (\"a\", \"b\"):\n        create(analyst, \"data-bites\", slug)\n    publish(analyst, \"data-bites\", create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"c\"))\n    create(analyst, \"reports\", \"draft-report\")\n    for slug in (\"live-1\", \"live-2\"):\n        publish(director, \"reports\", create(director, \"reports\", slug))\n\n    assert counts(analyst) == counts(director) == {\n        \"data-bite-published\": (\"/admin/data-bites?status=published\", \"Data Bites published\", \"1\"),\n        \"data-bite-draft\": (\"/admin/data-bites?status=draft\", \"Data Bite drafts\", \"2\"),\n        \"report-published\": (\"/admin/reports?status=published\", \"Reports published\", \"2\"),\n        \"report-draft\": (\"/admin/reports?status=draft\", \"Report drafts\", \"1\"),\n    }\n\n\ndef test_each_count_matches_the_list_it_links_to(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    publish(director, \"reports\", create(director, \"reports\", \"live\"))\n    create(director, \"reports\", \"draft\")\n    for href, _, number in counts(director).values():\n        assert len(re.findall(r'<tr id=\"[a-z-]+-\\d+\" role=\"row\">', director.get(href).text)) == int(number)\n\n\n# --- 01 Waiting for you ----------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_the_director_waits_on_draft_reports_and_not_published_ones(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    by_analyst = create(analyst, \"reports\", \"cds\")\n    by_director = create(director, \"reports\", \"factbook\")\n    publish(director, \"reports\", create(analyst, \"reports\", \"live\"))\n    create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"bite-draft\")  # a Data Bite isn't the Director's to publish\n\n    assert sorted(waiting(director)) == sorted([f\"report-{by_analyst}\", f\"report-{by_director}\"])\n\n\ndef test_the_directors_draft_reports_are_oldest_update_first(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    newer, older = create(analyst, \"reports\", \"newer\"), create(analyst, \"reports\", \"older\")\n    set_updated(\"reports\", newer, \"2026-09-30 12:00:00\")\n    set_updated(\"reports\", older, \"2026-09-01 12:00:00\")\n    assert waiting(director) == [f\"report-{older}\", f\"report-{newer}\"]\n\n\ndef test_each_waiting_report_has_review_and_who_drafted_it(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    rid = create(analyst, \"reports\", \"cds\")\n    set_updated(\"reports\", rid, \"2026-09-14 10:00:00\")\n    row = item(director.get(\"/admin\").text, \"waiting\", f\"report-{rid}\")\n    assert f'<a href=\"/admin/reports/{rid}\">Cds</a>' in row\n    assert '<span class=\"badge-state badge-state-draft\">Draft</span>' in row\n    assert f'<a datetime=\"2026-09-14T10:00:00\">2026-09-14</time>') in row\n\n\ndef test_an_analyst_waits_on_their_own_drafts_of_both_kinds(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    riley = second_analyst(director)\n    bite, report = create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"mine\"), create(analyst, \"reports\", \"my-report\")\n    set_updated(\"data_bites\", bite, \"2026-09-01 12:00:00\")\n    set_updated(\"reports\", report, \"2026-09-20 12:00:00\")\n    publish(analyst, \"data-bites\", create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"mine-live\"))\n    create(riley, \"data-bites\", \"rileys\")\n    create(riley, \"reports\", \"rileys-report\")\n    create(director, \"reports\", \"directors\")\n\n    # Most recently updated first: where they left off.\n    assert waiting(analyst) == [f\"report-{report}\", f\"data-bite-{bite}\"]\n    assert len(waiting(riley)) == 2 and f\"data-bite-{bite}\" not in waiting(riley)\n\n\ndef test_each_of_an_analysts_drafts_has_edit_and_its_kind(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bite = create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"mine\")\n    row = item(analyst.get(\"/admin\").text, \"waiting\", f\"data-bite-{bite}\")\n    assert f'<a class=\"button-secondary\" href=\"/admin/data-bites/{bite}\">Edit</a>' in row\n    assert \"Data Bite · updated\" in row\n\n\ndef test_waiting_says_so_when_it_is_empty(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    publish(director, \"reports\", create(director, \"reports\", \"live\"))\n    assert \"No draft Reports are waiting.\" in section(director.get(\"/admin\").text, \"waiting-title\")\n    assert \"You have no drafts.\" in section(analyst.get(\"/admin\").text, \"waiting-title\")\n    assert waiting(director) == waiting(analyst) == []\n\n\ndef test_waiting_says_what_only_the_director_can_do(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert \"Only the Director can publish a Report\" in section(page, \"waiting-title\")\n\n\n# --- 02 Recently changed -----------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_recently_changed_is_the_8_newest_of_both_kinds(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    ids = []\n    for n in range(10):\n        kind, table = ((\"reports\", \"reports\") if n % 2 else (\"data-bites\", \"data_bites\"))\n        item_id = create(director, kind, f\"item-{n}\")\n        set_updated(table, item_id, f\"2026-09-{n + 10:02d} 12:00:00\")\n        ids.append((\"report-\" if n % 2 else \"data-bite-\") + item_id)\n    assert recent(director) == list(reversed(ids))[:8]\n\n\ndef test_each_recent_item_has_its_state_date_kind_and_author(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    bite = create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"fall\")\n    publish(analyst, \"data-bites\", bite)\n    set_updated(\"data_bites\", bite, \"2026-09-12 08:30:00\")\n    row = item(director.get(\"/admin\").text, \"recent\", f\"data-bite-{bite}\")\n    assert f'<a href=\"/admin/data-bites/{bite}\">Fall</a>' in row\n    assert '<span class=\"badge-state badge-state-published\">Published</span>' in row\n    assert '<time class=\"text-mono\" client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert 'href=\"/admin/content\">All content</a>' in section(page, \"recent-title\")\n\n\ndef test_recently_changed_says_so_when_there_is_nothing(client_as):\n    assert \"Nothing yet.\" in section(client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\").text, \"recent-title\")\n\n\n# --- The side panels -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef panel(page: str, title: str) -> str | None:\n    match = re.search(rf'<div (\"admin\", \"editor\"):\n        site = panel(client_as(role).get(\"/admin\").text, \"The public site\")\n        assert site and \"<code>uv run cms publish</code>\" in site\n        assert '<a href=\"/\">View the site ↗</a>' in site\n\n\ndef test_only_the_director_has_the_homepage_panel_with_when_it_was_saved(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE homepage SET updated_at = '2026-09-28 16:00:00'\")\n    homepage = panel(director.get(\"/admin\").text, \"Homepage\")\n    assert homepage homepage\n    assert panel(analyst.get(\"/admin\").text, \"Homepage\") is None\n\n\n# --- Nothing leaks -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_nothing_from_the_dashboard_reaches_the_public_site(client_as, tmp_path):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    create(analyst, \"reports\", \"unreleased-cds\", title=\"Unreleased CDS draft\")\n    publish(director, \"reports\", create(director, \"reports\", \"factbook\"))\n    site = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    for path in site.rglob(\"*.html\"):\n All of it is derived from what is stored.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form, second_analyst\nfrom tests.test_t22_lists import create\n\n\ndef section(page: str, title_id: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(rf'<section class=\"section-console\" aria-labelledby=\"{title_id}\">(.*?)</section>',\n                      page, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"no section #{title_id}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef listed(page: str, title_id: str, list_key: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"A section's items, top to bottom, as \"<type key>-<id>\".\"\"\"\n    return re.findall(rf'<li id=\"{list_key}-([a-z-]+-\\d+)\"', section(page, title_id))\n\n\ndef waiting(c: TestClient) -> list[str]:\n    return listed(c.get(\"/admin\").text, \"waiting-title\", \"waiting\")\n\n\ndef recent(c: TestClient) -> list[str]:\n    return listed(c.get(\"/admin\").text, \"recent-title\", \"recent\")\n\n\ndef item(page: str, list_key: str, key: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(rf'<li id=\"{list_key}-{key}\">(.*?)</li>', page, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"{list_key}-{key} is not listed\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef set_updated(table: str, item_id: str, stamp: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Setup only: when an item was last updated.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\", (stamp, item_id))\n\n\ndef publish(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str) -> None:\n    assert post_form(c, f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n\n\n# --- The head ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_the_head_has_today_the_role_and_both_new_buttons(client_as):\n    today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat()  # stored times are UTC\n    for role, label in ((\"admin\", \"Director\"), (\"editor\", \"Analyst\")):\n        page = client_as(role).get(\"/admin\").text\n        head = re.search(r'<div class=\"head-page\">(.*?)</div>\\s*<dl class=\"figures-console\">',\n                         page, re.S).group(1)\n        assert \"<h1>Dashboard</h1>\" in head\n        assert f'<dt>Today</dt><dd class=\"text-mono\"><time datetime=\"{today}\">{today}</time></dd>' in head\n        assert f\"<dt>Signed in as</dt><dd>{label}</dd>\" in head\n        assert '<a class=\"button-secondary\" href=\"/admin/reports/new\">New Report</a>' in head\n        assert '<a class=\"button-primary\" href=\"/admin/data-bites/new\">New Data Bite</a>' in head\n\n\n# --- The counts ----------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef counts(c: TestClient) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Each count as {id: (href, label, number)}.\"\"\"\n    return {key: (href, label, number) for key, href, label, number in re.findall(\n        r'<div id=\"count-([a-z-]+)\"><dt><a href=\"([^\"]+)\">([^<]+)</a></dt>'\n        r'<dd class=\"text-mono\">(\\d+)</dd></div>', c.get(\"/admin\").text)}\n\n\ndef test_four_counts_each_linking_to_its_filtered_list(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    for slug in (\"a\", \"b\"):\n        create(analyst, \"data-bites\", slug)\n    publish(analyst, \"data-bites\", create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"c\"))\n    create(analyst, \"reports\", \"draft-report\")\n    for slug in (\"live-1\", \"live-2\"):\n extends \"base.html\" %}\n{#- The Dashboard (spec #25, T24): the counts, what is waiting for the user,\n    what changed lately, and where publishing goes. #}\n{%- macro iso_date(stamp) %}<time class=\"text-mono\" datetime=\"{{ stamp | replace(\" \", \"T\") }}\">{{ stamp[:10] }}</time>{% endmacro %}\n{%- macro state_badge(item) %}<span class=\"badge-state badge-state-{{ item.status }}\">{{ status_labels[item.status] }}</span>{% endmacro %}\n{% block content %}\n  <div class=\"head-page\">\n    <div>\n      <h1>Dashboard</h1>\n      <dl class=\"facts-page text-label\"><div><dt>Today</dt><dd class=\"text-mono\"><time datetime=\"{{ today }}\">{{ today }}</time></dd></div><div><dt>Signed in as</dt><dd>{{ user.role | role_label }}</dd></div></dl>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"actions-page\"><a class=\"button-secondary\" href=\"{{ path_for('new_report_form') }}\">New Report</a><a class=\"button-primary\" href=\"{{ path_for('new_bite_form') }}\">New Data Bite</a></div>\n  </div>\n\n  <dl class=\"figures-console\">\n  {%- for ctype, by_status in counts.items() %}\n    {%- for status, label in ((\"published\", ctype.plural ~ \" published\"), (\"draft\", ctype.noun ~ \" drafts\")) %}\n    <div id=\"count-{{ ctype.key }}-{{ status }}\"><dt><a href=\"{{ path_for(ctype.list_route) }}?status={{ status }}\">{{ label }}</a></dt><dd class=\"text-mono\">{{ by_status[status] }}</dd></div>\n    {%- endfor %}\n  {%- endfor %}\n  </dl>\n\n  <div class=\"grid-dashboard\">\n    <div>\n      <section class=\"section-console\" aria-labelledby=\"waiting-title\">\n        <div class=\"head-section\"><span class=\"text-mono\">01</span><h2 id=\"waiting-title\">Waiting for you</h2>\n          {%- if user.role == \"admin\" %}<span class=\"head-section-note\">Only the Director can publish a Report</span>{% endif %}</div>\n        {%- if waiting %}\n        <ul class=\"list-console list-console-items\">\n        {%- for row in waiting %}{% set item = row.item %}\n          <li id=\"waiting-{{ row.ctype.key }}-{{ item.id }}\"><span class=\"list-console-title\"><a href=\"{{ row.edit_path }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></span>{{ state_badge(item) }}\n            {%- if user.role == \"admin\" %}<a class=\"button-secondary\" href=\"{{ row.edit_path }}\">Review</a>\n            <span class=\"list-console-meta\">Drafted by {{ item.author_name }} ({{ item.author_role | role_label }}) · updated {{ iso_date(item.updated_at) }}</span>\n            {%- else %}<a class=\"button-secondary\" href=\"{{ row.edit_path }}\">Edit</a>\n            <span class=\"list-console-meta\">{{ row.ctype.noun }} · updated {{ iso_date(item.updated_at) }}</span>\n            {%- endif %}</li>\n        {%- endfor %}\n        </ul>\n        {%- else %}\n        <p class=\"empty-console\">{{ \"No draft Reports are waiting.\" if user.role == \"admin\" else \"You have no drafts.\" }}</p>\n        {%- endif %}\n      </section>\n\n      <section class=\"section-console\" aria-labelledby=\"recent-title\">\n        <div class=\"head-section\"><span class=\"text-mono\">02</span><h2 id=\"recent-title\">Recently changed</h2><a class=\"head-section-end text-label\" href=\"{{ path_for('content_list') }}\">All content</a></div>\n        {%- if recent %}\n        <ul class=\"list-console list-console-items\">\n        {%- for row in recent %}{% set item = row.item %}\n          <li id=\"recent-{{ row.ctype.key }}-{{ item.id }}\"><span class=\"list-console-title\"><a href=\"{{ row.edit_path }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></span>{{ state_badge(item) }}{{ iso_date(item.updated_at) }}\n            <span class=\"list-console-meta\">{{ row.ctype.noun }} · {{ item.author_name }}</span></li>\n        {%- endfor %}\n        </ul>\n        {%- else %}\n        <p class=\"empty-console\">Nothing yet.</p>\n        {%- endif %}\n      </section>\n    </div>\n\n    <aside aria-label=\"The site\">\n      <div class=\"panel-console\"><h2>The public site</h2>\n        <p>Publishing marks an item as Published here. It reaches the public site at the next export:</p>\n        <code>uv run cms publish</code>\n        <p class=\"panel-console-end\"><a href=\"{{ path_for('home') }}\">View the site ↗</a></p>\n      </div>\n      {%- if homepage_saved %}\n      <div class=\"panel-console\"><h2>Homepage</h2>\n        <p>Headline, intro, and Key figures. }\n.list-console-title { font-weight: 700; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.list-console-title a { color: var(--color-ink); text-decoration: none; }\n.list-console-title a:hover { color: var(--color-purple); margin: 0; }\n.figures-console > div { border-left: 1px solid var(--color-line); display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 1.1rem 1.1rem 1.25rem; }\n.figures-console > div:first-child { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }\n.figures-console dd { font: 500 2.4rem/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: -0.04em; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; }\n.figures-console dt { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; }\n.figures-console dt a { color: inherit; }\n.figures-console dt a:hover { color: var(--color-ink); }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) {\n  .figures-console { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }\n  .figures-console > div:nth-child(odd) { border-left: 0;
